ai_summary: Lotus Global Enterprises Limited has significantly reduced its stake in A B Cotspin India Limited, divesting 2.60% of its shares via open market transactions. This disposal lowers their holding from 6.50% to 3.90%, bringing them below the 5% regulatory disclosure threshold. This reduction by a non-promoter entity could signal a change in investment strategy or reduced confidence in A B Cotspin, potentially impacting market perception.
